stemMd: A heterozygote has linked alleles in the arrangement AB/ab. A test cross produces 42 AB, 43 ab, 8 Ab and 7 aB offspring. What is the recombination frequency?
explanationMd: AB and ab match the parental arrangements. The two recombinant classes total 8 plus 7 out of 100, giving 15%. Count both recombinant classes once each.

distractorRationale.a: Both recombinant classes must be included.
distractorRationale.c: This doubles an already complete recombinant count.
distractorRationale.e: This counts parental classes rather than recombinants.
distractorRationale.d: The observed recombinant proportion is not one half.
